mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox (id, platform, bot_id, group_id, type, payload, turn_id, task_id, trace_context, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{type}, #{payload}, #{turnId}, #{taskId}, #{traceContext}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, type, payload, turn_id AS turnId, task_id AS taskId, trace_context AS traceContext, status, report, error_code AS errorCode, settled_at AS settledAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM outbox WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, type, payload, turn_id AS turnId, task_id AS taskId, trace_context AS traceContext, status, report, error_code AS errorCode, settled_at AS settledAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM outbox WHERE turn_id = #{turnId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, type, payload, turn_id AS turnId, task_id AS taskId, trace_context AS traceContext, status, report, error_code AS errorCode, settled_at AS settledAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM outbox WHERE turn_id = #{turnId} AND status IN ('pending', 'dispatching') ORDER BY id

SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, type, payload, turn_id AS turnId, task_id AS taskId, trace_context AS traceContext, status, report, error_code AS errorCode, settled_at AS settledAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM outbox WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox SET status = 'dispatching' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE outbox SET status = 'pending' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'dispatching'
UPDATE outbox SET status = 'pending' WHERE status = 'dispatching' AND created_at < #{deadline}
